content.text: {"suite":"BugReports","cases":["form ids match the server, and every label and reply line exists in UICopy","validation: malformed packets drop, every field is checked, unknown fields ignored","notes: trimmed, control characters and runs of space collapsed, 200 characters, UTF-8 safe","filtering: the note goes through the injected filter for the reporter; anything hidden or failed is not stored","records hold the UserId and checked context only; size is capped; one console line per report","rate limits: 20 s gap, 3 per 10 minutes, 20 per day across servers, server hourly cap, duplicates, one in flight","store failure: the player is thanked, the report waits on the server and lands on retry, or is dropped after 3 tries","shards: deterministic UserId routing, same user shares cross-server window, full shard is independent","legacy routing is fail closed, preserves legacy daily limits, and empty legacy permits shards","immutable retries stay on original day and route; identity dedupes before full/window/day caps","merged recent reads all day keys, sorts and dedupes before limiting; strict purge and erasure","purge: day keys 30 or more days old are removed, once a day across servers","owner-only read: recent reports newest first, filters, 30-day window, erase by UserId","form: send needs a kind and a category, waits out the cooldown; defaults; chip flow; log lines; packet"],"context":"Edit fresh cloned Server + Shared; injected text/filter/DataStore adapters only"}
